articles.원문 요약: The first batch of concrete has been poured for the nuclear island of the high-temperature gas-cooled reactor that forms part of the initial phase of the Jiangsu Xuwei Nuclear Heating and Power Plant, China National Nuclear Corporation has announced.

articles.제목: Calogena awarded EU funding for SMR deployment
articles.원문 요약: French small modular reactor developer Calogena has been awarded EUR40 million (USD44.6 million) through the European Commission's Innovation Fund to support the potential construction of its first commercial nuclear reactor in Pierrelatte, in southern France.

articles.제목: NAC to supply used fuel storage solution for Norway
articles.원문 요약: NAC International of the USA has been contracted to deliver casks for the dry storage of Norway's used nuclear fuel from the former research reactors at Halden and Kjeller.

articles.제목: X-energy selects Fluor for second Xe-100 project
articles.원문 요약: Fluor Corporation is to provide design and engineering services to support the second-of-a-kind US project featuring X-energy's Xe-100, at Energy Northwest's proposed Cascade Advanced Energy Facility near Richland, Washington.

articles.제목: Reactor components completed for El Dabaa 1
articles.원문 요약: All the key components have now been manufactured for the first unit’s reactor at Egypt's El Dabaa Nuclear Power Plant.
